description: This file defines a class 'Standardize' in the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for normalizing a value or array of values based on a given mean and standard deviation, used in statistical calculations within PHPSpreadSheet.

classes.name: Standardize
classes.description: A class for standardizing numerical data based on mean and standard deviation, extending StatisticalValidations and utilizing ArrayEnabled trait.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Calculates the standardized value for a given value, mean, and standard deviation. Supports array inputs and handles invalid data or zero/negative standard deviations.
